content: Remain calm, serene, always in command of yourself. You will then find out how easy it is to get along.
author: Paramahansa Yogananda
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. Loneliness is the painful ache of feeling incomplete, while solitude is the rich discovery of your own inner presence. In a world full of constant stimulation and notifications, being alone with your thoughts can feel intimidating.

Paramahansa Yogananda understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Yet silence is the only space where you can hear what your life is actually trying to say to you. When you make peace with quiet, you stop running to distractions to save you from yourself.
reflectionPrompt: What would it feel like to release the need to control the outcome of the next hour?
